messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime-p95/p99 detector — p99 > 2.5s for last 5m on /v1/generate (EU region). Trigger: latency-anomaly. Pager sent to oncall.
oncall-zoe: ack — I'm oncall. joining bridge now. creating short-lived bridge and posting link.
prodops-maria: link: https://meet.redwood/bridge/3234567890 (passcode: triage)
prodops-maria: quick ask — any customer-facing outages? CS: please chime in.
cs-janet: seeing elevated errors for acct-42 and some EU orgs, customers reporting slow responses in support tickets. severity: medium so far.
sre-lee: quick signal check: p95 spike started ~3234567560, p99 is sustained at ~2.8s. No spike in error rate yet.
eng-ryan: checking runtime pool: a few runtime pods show CPU saturation on seq-length spike. likely KV cache pressure and longer decode paths.
sre-lee: running tail query on metrics: `sum(rate(request_duration_ms_bucket{le="2000"}[5m]))` low, but >2000 bucket rising.
eng-ryan: can we toggle degraded output mode to cap max_tokens to 256 for bursty routes? low effort fallback.
oncall-zoe: doing quick mitigations: 1) enable degraded output for route /v1/generate 2) roll 20% traffic to backup smaller model (gpt-small-v1) 3) increase autoscale max for EU runtime pool
prodops-maria: applied route split: 20% -> gpt-small-v1. Degraded-output flag set (max_tokens=256). Autoscaler target increased to +30%.
sre-lee: watching graphs — p99 dropped from 2.8s -> 1.9s within 60s. p95 also trending down. Good sign.
cs-janet: notifying affected customers via support with ETA ~15m. giving mitigation notes and asking for any recent heavy prompt patterns.
eng-ryan: added temporary KV cache bypass on 2 pods to isolate spool contention — `kubectl patch deploy runtime-eu --patch '...orphans...'` (note: will revert after).
sre-lee: checking traces: majority of slow requests show decode-heavy tail; attention kernel fallback on some quantized kernels. kernel selection fallback kicked in during spike.
oncall-zoe: decision: keep mitigations for 20m and run deeper postmortem if recurring. opening incident document.
prodops-maria: incident doc: https://redwood.atlassian/incidents/IR-3234 (created). tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml.
eng-ryan: next steps for follow-up: 1) collect a sample of ~200 slow requests with full trace + kv-cache metrics 2) reproduce with seq-length distribution from last 30m 3) re-evaluate kernel selection heuristics for quantized paths
sre-lee: agreed. also enable deeper logging for affected runtime shards for 30m (rate-limited).
cs-janet: will compile customer list and update support thread once we confirm stable SLO.
oncall-zoe: call summary: mitigations applied (route split + degraded output + autoscale). customer impact limited but ongoing monitoring. if p99 creeps back >2.5s we re-escalate to oncall lead. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: RESOLVE: detector returned to baseline at 3234568120. auto-update sent.
oncall-zoe: closing bridge in 5. leaving incident doc open for postmortem tasks. thanks all.
cs-janet: thanks — I'll update customers after postmortem notes are in.
eng-ryan: leaving notes in runtime repo about kernel fallback detection and suggested threshold tweaks.
sre-lee: follow-up owner: eng-runtime (ryan). postmortem target: draft in 48h.
oncall-zoe: end of thread.
